bayts.text: I ask forgiveness of God the Immense, and I turn to Him repentant, from sins manifest and from sins hidden.
I asked Him, by the right of the Face of God, for forgiveness from the whole of the forbidden things.
I repented to Him of the whole of the minor sins, together with the major ones and those of the inner thoughts.
O Forgiver! Forgive me all that has gone before, and what comes after, and what lies between the two.
Make me understand knowledge, and increase me in knowledge, and in action, and in good conduct, and in understanding.
My Lord, unveil for me the beneficial sciences, and make my life protected from misery.
Unveil for me the secrets and the obscure matters, O Best of those who unveil an obscure secret.
Gather for me all the good that has been scattered in my writing, and purify my mind.
Guide me, in my greatest reflection, O my Lord, by "Be!" (Kun), and preserve my pen from error.
Grant me, O Most Generous, in recitation, abundant good from You, and sweetness.
Bless for me, O God, my life, and make my heart the dwelling of Your verses.
Grant me to be glad tidings for everyone who repents, and make manifest to me the outward realities together with the unseen.
